reviewed_by: Claude, based on an independently validated by-design finding and a scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Refusals for a third execution version (target_execution, the per-project prepare_execution switch, the deployment status detail and the staged deployer result) now name the projects and unowned workers that keep each resident version and how a version retires. The selected tests cover the new blocker text on SQLite and PostgreSQL, the prepare_execution refusal, the staged deployer's structured blockers, and the existing third-version staging, targeting and resume paths.
exclusions: No UI consumes /deployment/status, so no frontend, native or browser coverage. The two-version limit and handoff behaviour are unchanged, so broader deployment suites are not selected.
